title: InfraBench: Evaluating Infrastructure Agents Across Layers, Lifecycle, and Risk
abstract: arXiv:2608.11234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Managing modern computing infrastructure has become a steadily harder problem due to the ever-increasing complexity. Recent advances in AI agents create a timely opportunity to automate infrastructure management tasks, but it remains unclear how well such agents can handle real-world infrastructure complexity. We present InfraBench, a benchmark suite for evaluating AI agents on realistic infrastructure tasks across the full system stack and full operational lifecycle with fine-grained risk assessment. Experiments with 15 agent-model configurations show that even the strongest agent cannot secure a full score across all tasks. translated_title: InfraBench：跨层级、生命周期和风险评估基础设施代理
translated_abstract: 管理现代计算基础设施由于日益增长的复杂性而变得越来越困难。人工智能代理的最新进展为自动化基础设施管理任务提供了及时的机遇，但尚不清楚此类代理能否处理现实世界的基础设施复杂性。我们提出了InfraBench，一个基准测试套件，用于评估AI代理在跨全系统栈和全操作生命周期的现实基础设施任务上的表现，并进行细粒度的风险评估。对15种代理模型配置的实验表明，即使最强的代理也无法在所有任务上获得满分。平均有效分数范围约为40%至88%（每种配置的标准误差为6-12分），每个任务重复三次的结果显示，顶级配置仍然只通过了部分尝试，而逐项检查评分暴露了一个普遍的失败模式：代理可能常规性地满足短期目标，但未能实现长期可靠性。
tldr: InfraBench是一个跨系统栈、生命周期和风险维度的基准测试套件，揭示了即使最强AI代理也无法完全掌握现实基础设施管理的复杂性，且普遍存在短期满足但长期失败的模式。
en_tdlr: InfraBench is a benchmark suite spanning layers, lifecycle, and risk, revealing that even the strongest AI agents cannot fully master real-world infrastructure management complexity, with a common pattern of satisfying short-term goals but failing long-term reliability.
